title: EEG-based brain-computer interface enables real-time robotic hand control at individual finger level
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Classify imagined or executed thumb/index/pinky activity in the source-defined binary and ternary conditions. Retrospective recorded decoding and online closed-loop control remain distinct targets.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Classify imagined or executed thumb/index/pinky activity in the source-defined binary and ternary conditions. Retrospective recorded decoding and online closed-loop control remain distinct targets.

Source-paper comparison for Original figure-specific offline finger-classification accuracy: Source offline classification accuracy needs its figure-specific window/trial rule recovered. Online cumulative finger decisions and a local hard-vote replay score are not interchangeable.
success_criteria: Recover a complete original offline paper panel, exact folds/session membership, decision rule and numeric EEGNet baseline before enabling same-task comparison.
Match imagery/execution, class roster, complete original participants, chronological training and source-prescribed calibration inputs; keep every trial’s overlapping windows together.
Compare against the source EEGNet training and fine-tuning procedure under identical allowed input and tuning budgets; nearest-centroid spectral references are calibration only.
Do not call improved replay accuracy a gain over the online human-adapting Base-versus-Finetune experiment.
Resolve S07 session-5 missing events without silently shrinking the original panel; predeclare task-specific effect and participant-level uncertainty. New participant-transfer splits are extensions.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: 21subject MAT archives; observed ZIP member inventory supports eeg.data128channels×time,1024Hz and1-based event samples by publisher/source documentation, not executed payload validation.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

data_contract.neural: Publisher schema and source loader agree: eeg.data128channels ×time, eeg.fsample1024Hz, eeg.time andchannel labels.
data_contract.labels: event.type Target/TrialEnd, event.sample1-based sample index, event.value1thumb/2index/4pinky; source subtracts1before slicing.
data_contract.leakage: Online files also contain prediction and prob_* output fields; these must be removed from candidate inputs, along with evaluation event targets.
data_contract.split: Reproduce original per-person chronological offline/prior-session training; report a separate predeclared participant-generalization extension. Group overlapping1s windows by their original trials and runs.
data_contract.controls: Motor imagery separately from execution; cue/eye/muscle/artifact nuisance controls, temporal alignment shuffle, no-neural and within-session class permutation; subject-level paired uncertainty.
data_contract.known_exclusion: Publisher reports missing event information for S07 OnlineImagery_Sess05_3class_Base; exclude or mark unusable before scoring.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Reproduce the offline-trained finger motor-imagery decoder and its recorded cross-session/fine-tuning comparisons; this does not reproduce a new human closed-loop robotic-control experiment.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

provenance.interpretation: Pins bind saved local evidence. Asset hashes are source-reported unless an explicit acquisition receipt says otherwise.

resources.measurement_status: No project runtime/peak-memory measurement found; archive byte counts/HEAD lengths are input metadata, not execution measurements.

episode.improvement_loop: After recovering the chosen original offline figure panel, iterate on its permitted participant/session training data and trial-grouped validation feedback. Respect MI/ME and binary/ternary source routes, including the two Base-folder route for binary fine-tuning. Keep overlapping windows within their original trial and log any preprocessing, EEGNet or calibration change without using final-session labels.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the exact offline figure estimand, original participant/session/run roster and exclusions, source MAT conversion, original folds, source-folder calibration access, EEG preprocessing, window-to-trial rule, EEGNet selection/fine-tuning recipe, aggregation and budgets before final scoring. Resolve missing S07 events before freezing the denominator.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and recovered native EEGNet baseline on the same complete original offline panel, retaining every condition and participant result. A same-Finetune-trial replay gain, participant-transfer split or changed calibration allowance is a separate extension. No offline output can establish improvement over the online human-control headline.
episode.baseline_policy: Use the figure-matched original offline EEGNet result and qualified rerun as distinct comparators. Keep the online binary/ternary headline scores, local nearest-centroid spectral reference, calibration-augmented replay reference and prospective participant-macro/bootstrap diagnostics separately labeled; none substitutes for the missing original offline baseline.
